FIELDS.NAME: Metro Post & Parcel Center
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Metro Post & Parcel Center operates as a full-service post office and shipping center providing a comprehensive range of mailing and shipping solutions to both individuals and businesses. Our core operations include processing domestic and international shipments, offering parcel pickup and drop-off services, and providing mailing supplies and consultative support for logistics management. 

We partner with respected carriers such as USPS, UPS, and FedEx to ensure reliable delivery options, and maintain a secure environment with surveillance systems and secure storage facilities. Our dedicated staff undergoes regular training in shipping procedures, customer service, and safety protocols, ensuring that every package is handled with care and professionalism.

Additionally, we focus on inventory management to maintain adequate supplies of shipping materials, enabling us to meet customer demands efficiently. We are committed to maintaining high standards and contributing to our strong reputation in the community. Our shipping center is located in a high-traffic area, making it accessible and convenient for customers.

Our mission is to provide exceptional service and a seamless shipping experience while ensuring the security and integrity of all transactions.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Description: On 05/12/2023, a theft incident occurred where postal items valued at $1,500 were stolen from the secure storage area after hours. The investigation is ongoing, and the current status is "Under review" with local law enforcement. Additionally, on 06/20/2023, a customer claimed a lost package worth $1,000, for which we have submitted a claim to our insurance provider, and the status is "Claim filed."
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9 AM - 6 PM; Saturday: 10 AM - 4 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class A, Grade 1, UL Listed Safe
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Surveillance cameras, security fencing, and on-site security personnel.
